projects.name: StructStudio
projects.description: Co-founded interactive code-visualization platform as an inaugural UB Forge fellow (1 of 14 from 250+ applicants), rendering real-time simulations of Trees, Heaps, and Graphs from raw program input. Shipped to production with sub-100ms render times at 300+ concurrent users, adopted across theory-level CS courses at the University at Buffalo, including CSE 250 (Data Structures & Algorithms).

projects.name: LoRA-Guided PPO
projects.description: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop paper (second author) on cost-aware multi-agent orchestration: a budget-aware controller learns which sub-agents to invoke on ToolBench, holding 100% task success.
